research_question: Did RCEP entry reallocate active supplier relationships within covered Chinese firms toward RCEP rather than Asian non-RCEP countries?

population.firm_universe: Valid listed tickers with at least one foreign supplier relationship active at year-end 2017.
population.candidate_panel: Balanced cross of frozen firms, 21 registered Asian countries, and years 2018-2024.
population.ticker_rule: Aggregate all valid FactSet cn_ids sharing a listed ticker; exclude 000000 and non-listed tickers.

treatment.preferred: Country-specific timing: 2022 except Indonesia and the Philippines in 2023; never for controls.

outcomes.primary: Inverse-hyperbolic-sine of the number of active supplier relationships from the firm to the candidate country at year-end.
secondary: Indicator for at least one active supplier relationship to the candidate country
Raw active supplier-link count estimated with fixed-effect Poisson
descriptive_network_measures: Firm-year RCEP share of active Asian supplier links
outcomes.interpretation: The coefficient is within-firm geographic reallocation, not a change in total sourcing or verified rules-of-origin use.

estimand: Within a listed firm-year, the differential post-entry change in active supplier-link intensity for RCEP versus Asian non-RCEP candidate countries.

estimating_equations.static: asinh(Links_fct) = alpha_fc + lambda_ft + beta TreatedCountryTime_ct + error_fct
estimating_equations.dynamic: Cohort-by-event interactions with event time -1 omitted, firm-country and firm-year fixed effects.
estimating_equations.randomization_inference: Exact or 9,999 assignments preserving 14 treated and 7 control country labels.

identifying_assumption: Absent RCEP, the within-firm geographic distribution of active supplier links across RCEP and Asian non-RCEP candidate countries would have evolved similarly after fixed firm-country differences and all firm-year shocks are removed.

data_gate.link_support: At least 100 active links in every treatment-group by pre/post cell.
data_gate.country_support: At least five countries in every group-period cell must have at least one positive active-link observation.
data_gate.firm_support: At least 50 firms must have positive links in both country groups during the pre period and at least 50 during the post period.
data_gate.balanced_panel: Every eligible firm-country dyad must have seven rows for 2018-2024.
data_gate.failure_rule: Failure of any condition closes the experiment before coefficient estimation.

identification_gate.economic_threshold: Maximum absolute aggregated lead <= 0.05 on the asinh link-count scale.
identification_gate.placebo: Positive evidence requires country-label randomization p < 0.05.
identification_gate.stop_rule: Pretrend failure stops before static effects, robustness, mechanisms, and heterogeneity.

evidence_gate.positive_result: Preferred staged estimate passes randomization inference, retains sign under uniform timing and secondary outcomes, and is not driven by one country.
evidence_gate.inconclusive: Identification passes but the observed estimate is ordinary under label assignments or too imprecise for the frozen 0.05 scale.
evidence_gate.integrity: No country or firm deletion is chosen using coefficient signs or significance.

amendment_rule: Any change after freeze is appended to pap/amendments.md before execution.
